translations.web: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
translations.bsb: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.
translations.kjv: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
